emergency.message: If you are in danger or thinking of ending your life, please call now. You are not alone.

operatorQuestions.opening: You can share only what you feel comfortable sharing. What would you like to tell us?
operatorQuestions.safeNow: Are you in a safe place right now?
operatorQuestions.accusedNearby: Is the person who harmed you near you right now?
operatorQuestions.suicidalThoughts: Are you having thoughts of ending your life?
operatorQuestions.suicidalIntent: Are you thinking of acting on these thoughts, or have you made a plan?
operatorQuestions.safePlace: Is there a safe place you can go to right now?
operatorQuestions.threatDetails: Has anyone threatened you or your family since the complaint?
operatorQuestions.whoCanHelp: Is there someone you trust who can be with you?
operatorQuestions.injury: Are you hurt, or do you need a doctor?
operatorQuestions.sayMore: Thank you for telling us. Is there anything else you would like us to know?
operatorQuestions.lowInterest: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
operatorQuestions.feelingDown: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by: Feeling down or hopeless
operatorQuestions.nervous: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by: Feeling nervous, worried or on edge
operatorQuestions.cannotStopWorrying: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by: Not being able to stop worrying
operatorQuestions.badDreams: In the past month, because of what happened, have you: Had bad dreams about it, or thought about it when you did not want to?
operatorQuestions.avoidance: In the past month, because of what happened, have you: Tried hard not to think about it, or stayed away from things that remind you of it?
operatorQuestions.onGuard: In the past month, because of what happened, have you: Felt constantly on guard, watchful or easily startled?
operatorQuestions.numb: In the past month, because of what happened, have you: Felt numb or cut off from people, activities or your surroundings?
operatorQuestions.guilt: In the past month, because of what happened, have you: Felt guilty, or unable to stop blaming yourself or others?

home.metaTitle: Nivara · Share what happened, in your own words
home.label: Built on Nivara for the NHAA helpline 14566
home.headline: You are not alone. Tell us what happened, in your own words.
home.lead: Trained helpline staff read what you share and arrange support. You get a case number to follow it.
home.preferTalk: Prefer to talk? Call NHAA helpline 14566.
home.demoOff: This portal is resting right now. If you need help, call the NHAA helpline 14566, or 112 in an emergency.
home.step1Body: Write or speak. A few simple questions may follow; you can skip any of them or stop at any time.
home.step2Body: When you submit, your case is registered and you see its docket ID. Keep it to follow your case.
home.step3Body: Helpline staff read what you shared and decide on support. With your case number you can see when support is arranged.
home.whoTitle: Only the people who need it, and only what they need.
home.whoLead: What each role can see is enforced on the server, not only hidden on the screen.
home.roleCounsellorBody: read what you share, to arrange the right support.
home.roleOperatorBody: can follow the conversation while it is happening.
home.roleDistrictBody: sees cases from your district, to decide on protection.
home.rolePoliceBody: see only the referral approved for them, never your words.
home.engineTitle: Nivara is a plug-in module. This portal is one of the ways in.
home.engineLead: The same engine takes NHAA's helpline, IVRS and chatbot. Safety rules run on every message, and trained staff decide every action.
home.trackLead: Enter the docket ID you were given. You will see where your case stands and the support arranged.

login.lead: Sign in to your role's portal: the queue in risk order, the evidence behind each case, the proposals waiting for a decision.
login.staffOnly: For helpline staff only. Every sign-in is recorded.
login.title: Staff sign in
login.leadPassword: Use the e-mail and password you were given.
login.leadTotp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.failed: Sign-in failed. Check your details and try again.
login.expired: The sign-in took too long. Start again with your e-mail and password.
login.unavailable: The server cannot reach the database right now, so nobody can sign in. Try again in a minute.

portal.notice: Demonstration. Please don't enter real names, numbers or addresses.

begin.title: Before we begin
begin.p1: What you share is read by trained helpline staff, to arrange support for you.
begin.p2: You can skip any question or stop at any time.
begin.p3: This is not a medical diagnosis.
begin.languageHint: The whole site and the questions will be in this language.
begin.districtHint: So that the right district team receives your case.
begin.talkTitle: You can talk to someone now
begin.talkBody: Call the NHAA helpline, or 112 in an emergency.

consent.textAnalysisHint: Your words are read with care to understand how urgent your situation is. Without this, only basic safety checks run.
consent.voiceAnalysisHint: If you choose to speak, the tone of your voice (pauses, pitch and pace) is also used to understand how urgent your situation is. Your voice is not recorded or stored.
consent.shareWithCounsellorHint: A trained counsellor may read what you share.
consent.followUpContactHint: Helpline staff may plan to follow up on your case.

share.title: How would you like to share?
share.lead: Choose one. It stays the same for this conversation.
share.writeBody: Type in your own words, at your own pace.
share.speakBody: Uses your microphone. Your voice is not recorded or stored.
share.speakNeedsConsent: Speaking needs your permission to listen to how you speak. Go back to give it, or write instead.
share.busy: The line is busy. You can write instead, or try again in a few minutes.

conv.placeholder: Write here… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
conv.languageNote: The conversation stays in the language chosen at the start; changing the language changes only the screen.

portal.closing: Thank you. You can add anything else, or press Finish when you are ready.

speak.questionNote: Read the question, then tap to speak. Tap Done when you have finished.
speak.heardNothing: We did not catch any words. You can speak again, or add a note on the Review step.
speak.micRefused: The microphone is not available. Allow it in your browser, or add what you want to say as a note on the Review step.
speak.unavailable: Listening is not available right now. You can add what you want to say as a note on the Review step.
speak.needsConsent: Speaking needs your permission to listen to how you speak.

review.title: Review
review.lead: These are your own words. Nothing else is added.
review.nothing: Nothing has been shared yet. You can add a note below.
review.noteLabel: Something wrong or missing? Add a note
review.noteHint: Earlier answers can't be changed; your note reaches staff with them.

registered.title: Your case is registered
registered.lead: Keep this docket ID. Helpline staff will see your case.

lost.title: This conversation is no longer here
lost.body: The page was reloaded or left, so the conversation was cleared. You can start again.

errors.LINE_BUSY: The line is busy. You can write instead, or try again in a few minutes.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Please wait a little and try again.
errors.CONSENT_REQUIRED: That needs a permission you did not give. You can start again and give it.
errors.INTERACTION_ENDED: This conversation has reached its limit. Please go to Review and submit it.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This conversation could not be found. Please start again.
errors.ANALYSIS_DEGRADED: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

queue.title: Case queue

queue.emptyHint: New cases appear here the moment they are registered.

pages.policeEmpty: No action requests for your district.
pages.welfareLead: Relief, rehabilitation, legal aid and medical support approved for your district.
pages.approvalsLead: Proposed support waits here until a person approves or rejects it. Emergency support that was auto-triggered is listed for review.
pages.auditLead: Every view, change and export, chained by hash so that any edit or deletion shows up.

district.empty: No High or Critical cases open in your district

case.notShared: Not shared: the person did not consent to sharing with a counsellor.
case.transcriptNoShare: The person did not consent to sharing their words with a counsellor.
